faq.question: Is this the university in Nagaland or Bengaluru?
faq.answer: No. This is the Tamil Nadu St Joseph University using sju.ac.in, listed by UGC at Keezhathanur in Tindivanam taluk. The Nagaland and Bengaluru universities and similarly named affiliated colleges are distinct institutions.

faq.question: Where will my programme be taught?
faq.answer: UGC lists the university at Keezhathanur, Tindivanam, and the university gives an Emmanuel Educity address on NH-32. It also lists administrative offices near Chennai and in Kanyakumari, with the registered office in Kanyakumari. Obtain the exact teaching campus on the written offer before making travel or accommodation commitments.

faq.question: Are all the undergraduate degrees three years?
faq.answer: No. Most of the base degrees listed here have an explicit three-year duration on their named university pages. Professional Accounting, Visual Communication and the combined Hotel, International Tourism and Aviation Management page each state four years. Confirm the precise award and any honours or research pathway rather than assuming a common duration.

faq.question: Which subjects do the computing degrees require?
faq.answer: The named BSc Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science pages require 10+2 with at least 50% and at least one of Mathematics, Business Mathematics, Statistics or Allied Mathematics. The general Computer Science page also lists a qualifying engineering-diploma alternative; the university must confirm the entry pattern and year for that route.

faq.question: What do the Commerce degrees require?
faq.answer: The named Commerce pages require 10+2 with a minimum aggregate of 50% and list Commerce/Accountancy as mandatory subjects. Confirm how the university assesses your exact school combination and any equivalent qualification.

faq.question: What are the postgraduate entry conditions?
faq.answer: MSW accepts any undergraduate degree with at least 50%. MSc Artificial Intelligence and Data Science lists specified computing, IT and related BSc, BCA, BE and BTech qualifications with 50% aggregate and requires Mathematics at Class 12. Obtain assessment of the exact prior degree before applying.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The university’s currently linked ordinances specify English as the medium of instruction and examination at all stages in all university courses. Confirm the detailed arrangements for any separate language paper or specialist assessment in the chosen syllabus.

faq.question: How should I use the fee figures?
faq.answer: Where available, the amounts are indicative annual course-fee references for an exact named Tindivanam degree in a secondary source. They are not confirmed isolated tuition. Ask the university for current itemised fees, category conditions, additional charges and refund terms. Fees for a similarly named Chennai listing should not automatically be transferred.

faq.question: Do Aviation or Social Work degrees confer a professional licence?
faq.answer: These are academic degrees. The Aviation award does not itself establish a pilot licence, and a Social Work degree does not guarantee eligibility for a regulated clinical role or government appointment. Check the separate requirements of the occupation you intend to pursue.

faq.question: Are overseas applicants automatically eligible?
faq.answer: The university provides an international admissions link, but the school and prior-degree conditions shown here do not establish individual foreign-qualification equivalence, fees or immigration eligibility. Obtain a written university assessment for the applicant’s precise qualification and category.
